prompt:
Fix the snippet snippets/blog-post-meta-defaults.liquid so that it shows fallback text for missing blog post metadata. All inputs are top-level variables. There is no section.settings. Inputs (each one a string or null): - article_title - author - published Output is a single line with no surrounding whitespace or newlines:

TITLE

By AUTHOR on DATE

For each input: 1. Trim leading and trailing whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines). 2. If the input is null, or the trimmed result is empty, use its fallback instead: - TITLE: Untitled post - AUTHOR: Staff Writer - DATE: Unscheduled 3. Otherwise output the trimmed value, HTML-escaped with the escape filter. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/blog-post-meta-defaults.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
